   490→function FlatReportRow({ reports, repeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: FlatReportRowProps) {
   491→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   492→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);

   495→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   496→    e.preventDefault();

   500→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   501→  };
   502→
   503→  const saveOperatorField = (field: 'name' | 'qth', value: string) => {
   504→    if (!form.operator?.id) return;
   505→    const original = field === 'name' ? (form.operator.name || '') : (form.operator.qth || '');
   506→    if (value === original) return;
   507→    apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${form.operator.id}`, {
   508→      method: 'PATCH',
   509→      body: JSON.stringify({ [field]: value || null }),
   510→    }).then(() => {
   511→      setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: { ...f.operator, [field]: value || null } }));
   512→    }).catch(() => {});
   513→  };
   514→
   515→  return (
   516→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   517→      {reports.length > 0 && (

   519→          <tbody>

   521→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   522→                {editingId === r.id ? (

   524→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap" onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); onEditSave(); } }}>

   526→                      <input value={editForm.opName} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opName: e.target.value })} placeholder="Name" className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 hidden sm:block" />

   529→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   530→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   531→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   532→                    </div>

   544→                    </td>

   102→      setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, organisator: val || null } : null);
   103→      setSaveStatus('saved');
   104→      savedTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus('idle'), 2000);
   105→    } catch {
   106→      setSaveStatus('idle');
   107→    }
   108→  };
   109→
   110→  if (loading) return <p className="text-gray-500 p-4">Laden...</p>;
   111→  if (!exercise) return <p className="text-red-500 p-4">Übung nicht gefunden</p>;
   112→
   113→  return (
   114→    <div className="space-y-4">
   115→      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
   116→        <h1 className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold text-[#1e3a5f] min-w-0">
   117→          <span className="block sm:inline">{exercise.name || 'Übung'}</span>
   118→          <span className="hidden sm:inline"> — </span>
   119→          <span className="block sm:inline text-sm sm:text-xl">{new Date(exercise.date + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('de-AT', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' })}</span>
   120→        </h1>
   121→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">

   124→            <input

   126→              value={organisator}
   127→              onChange={e => setOrganisator(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
   128→              onBlur={e => updateOrganisator(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
   129→              placeholder="Rufzeichen"
   130→              className={`border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-mono uppercase w-24 sm:w-28 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 ${organisator ? 'border-gray-300' : 'border-[#c8102e] placeholder-[#c8102e]/60'}`}
   131→            />
   132→            {saveStatus === 'saving' && <span className="text-xs text-amber-600 animate-pulse">Speichern...</span>}
   133→            {saveStatus === 'saved' && <span className="text-xs text-green-600">Gespeichert</span>}
   134→          </div>
   135→          <Link to={`/exercises/${id}/setup`} className="bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-700 px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs sm:text-sm">
   136→            Einrichten

   139→            Auswertung

   141→        </div>

Now I have the complete picture. Here's the full re-analysis aligned with the confirmed design:

---

## Re-Analysis: Repeater Confusion

### Confirmed Design (correct as-is)
- **Frequenzen/LandMode** = all repeaters with `is_linked=0` (standalone non-OE-Link repeaters)
- **OE-Link/BundMode** = all repeaters with `is_linked=1` (OE-Link network repeaters)

### Finding 1: Lachtal in Einrichtung — NOT a bug

`ExerciseSetupPage.tsx:79-80` correctly filters: `!r.is_linked`

- **Lachtal 2m** (OE6XDG, 145.700 MHz, `is_linked=0`) → shown in setup/Frequenzen — **correct**
- **Lachtal 70cm** (OE6XDG, 438.675 MHz, `is_linked=1`) → hidden from setup, only in OE-Link — **correct**

Lachtal genuinely has two separate repeaters. The 2m one is a standalone repeater, the 70cm one is the OE-Link einstiegspunkt. Same for Schöckl (2m standalone vs 70cm OE-Link).

### Finding 2: "Entries confused between Schöckl 2m and Schöckl 70cm" — UX problem, not data bug

The filtering is correct:
- `LandMode.tsx:64` — `if (r.is_linked) continue;` → only shows non-linked repeater cards
- `LandMode.tsx:197` — `reports.filter(r => r.repeater_id === rep.repeater_id)` → only shows reports for that specific repeater
- `BundMode.tsx:219` — `if (!r.repeater_is_linked) return false;` → only shows reports against linked repeaters

Reports are stored with the correct `repeater_id`. A Schöckl 2m report stays in Frequenzen, a Schöckl 70cm report stays in OE-Link. **No cross-contamination.**

However, there are two UX issues that likely cause confusion:

**a) BundMode dropdown shows ALL linked repeaters in every Bezirk row** (`BundMode.tsx:452-463`):
```
linkedRepeaters.map(r => <option ...>)
```
Every Bezirk row shows a dropdown with ALL 15+ linked repeaters (Hermannskogel, Gaisberg, Schöckl 70cm, Lachtal 70cm, Magdalensberg, etc.). Users can accidentally select the wrong one. Per-BL default is the first linked repeater in that BL (`BundMode.tsx:51`), but for OE6 both Schöckl 70cm and Lachtal 70cm are options.

**b) Names are similar** — "Schöckl 2m" (Frequenzen) vs "Schöckl (OE6XAG)" in the dropdown (OE-Link). Without the explicit "2m"/"70cm" distinction visible, it's easy to get confused which mode you're in.

### Finding 3: "Frequenzen different from OE-Link" — by design, confirmed

Different repeaters = different frequencies. This is correct.

### Potential Improvements (TODO list)

| # | Issue | Severity | Fix |
|---|-------|----------|-----|
| 1 | **BundMode dropdown too broad** — every Bezirk row shows ALL linked repeaters instead of just those relevant to the Bundesland | Medium | Filter dropdown to show only linked repeaters in the current BL (+ Magdalensberg as fallback) |
| 2 | **No band indicator in BundMode dropdown** — dropdown shows `site_name (callsign)` but not the band/frequency | Low | Add frequency or band to dropdown label, e.g. "Schöckl 70cm (438.875)" |
| 3 | **No visual distinction for which repeater a report was entered against in BundMode** — the report rows show `r.repeater_name` but it's not prominent | Low | Already shows at `BundMode.tsx:435` but only on sm+ screens (`hidden sm:table-cell`) |
| 4 | **Einstiegspunkte table unused in BundMode** — the DB has an `einstiegspunkte` table with abbreviations (HK, GB, SCHÖ, LT, etc.) but BundMode doesn't leverage it for the dropdown | Low | Could use einstiegspunkte to label the dropdown entries more clearly |

None of these are data corruption bugs. The system correctly separates linked vs non-linked repeaters. The issues are purely UX-related — the dropdown showing too many options makes it easy to accidentally select the wrong repeater.

#!/bin/bash
# Backup bosarsalog SQLite DB to synology
set -e

REMOTE="straliadmin@192.168.1.206"
REMOTE_PATH="/volume1/docker/bosarsalog"
DB_VOLUME="/var/lib/docker/volumes/bosarsalog_bosarsalog-data/_data"
BACKUP_FILE="/tmp/bosarsalog-$(date +%Y%m%d).db"

# SQLite safe copy via .backup command inside the container
docker exec -u app bosarsalog node -e "
const Database = require('better-sqlite3');
const db = new Database('/data/bosarsalog.db');
db.backup('/data/backup.db').then(() => { db.close(); });
"

# Copy backup out of volume
sudo cp "${DB_VOLUME}/backup.db" "$BACKUP_FILE"
sudo chown achildrenmile "$BACKUP_FILE"
sudo rm -f "${DB_VOLUME}/backup.db"

# Ensure remote directory exists and transfer
ssh "$REMOTE" "mkdir -p $REMOTE_PATH"
cat "$BACKUP_FILE" | ssh "$REMOTE" "cat > ${REMOTE_PATH}/bosarsalog.db"

# Cleanup local
rm -f "$BACKUP_FILE"

echo "$(date): bosarsalog backup completed" >> /home/achildrenmile/infra/backup.log
```

Perfect! Now I have all the information I need to provide a comprehensive analysis. Let me compile the findings:

## Analysis Report: Signal Report Bezirk Assignment and Edit Flow

Based on my examination of the codebase, here are the key findings:

### 1. HOW BEZIRK_CODE IS SET WHEN A REPORT IS CREATED

**LandMode.tsx (Line 112-144):**
- When a report is created via `handleBezirkSubmit()`, the `bezirk_code` is explicitly passed from the BezirkRow component
- The bezirk code comes from the UI hierarchy: reports are organized under BezirkRow components that receive a `bezirk` object
- Line 127: `bezirk_code: (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') ? bezirkCode : null`
- Special handling: If the code is '??' (Sonstige/Other), it's converted to `null` instead of storing the literal "??"
- The bezirk code is determined by which BezirkRow the user submits the form under

**BundMode.tsx (Line 124-158):**
- Similar pattern: `handleBezirkSubmit()` receives the bezirk code and passes it to the API
- Line 140: `bezirk_code: (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') ? bezirkCode : null`
- Same "??" → null conversion logic
- The form is submitted with the bezirk code from the BezirkRow section where it was entered

### 2. INLINE EDIT MODE - FIELDS SHOWN

**Edit Mode Display (Both LandMode and BundMode):**

When a report row enters edit mode (triggered by clicking the report row), the edit form shows these fields:
- **Callsign** (static, read-only display): Shows `r.callsign` as plain text (line 388/418)
- **Operator Name** (opName): Input field, hidden on mobile (line 389/419)
- **QTH** (opQth): Input field, hidden on mobile (line 390/420)
- **Rapport** (RST format): Editable input field with auto-focus (line 391/421)
- **Notes**: Editable input field (line 392/422)

**Key Limitation:** The edit form does NOT include a bezirk_code field. The bezirk assignment is NOT editable inline.

**Code Location:**
- LandMode.tsx lines 385-395 (BezirkRow edit mode)
- BundMode.tsx lines 415-425 (BezirkRow edit mode)

### 3. DOES THE PATCH ENDPOINT SUPPORT BEZIRK_CODE UPDATES?

**YES** - The PATCH endpoint fully supports `bezirk_code` updates:

**server/src/routes/exercises.ts lines 287-313:**
```typescript
exercisesRouter.patch('/:id/reports/:rid', (req, res) => {
  const db = getDb();
  const { readability, strength, db_over_s9, einstiegspunkt_id, notes, is_op_marker, bezirk_code } = req.body;
  const updates: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];
  if (readability !== undefined) { updates.push('readability = ?'); params.push(readability); }
  if (strength !== undefined) { updates.push('strength = ?'); params.push(strength); }
  if (db_over_s9 !== undefined) { updates.push('db_over_s9 = ?'); params.push(db_over_s9); }
  if (einstiegspunkt_id !== undefined) { updates.push('einstiegspunkt_id = ?'); params.push(einstiegspunkt_id); }
  if (notes !== undefined) { updates.push('notes = ?'); params.push(notes); }
  if (is_op_marker !== undefined) { updates.push('is_op_marker = ?'); params.push(is_op_marker ? 1 : 0); }
  if (bezirk_code !== undefined) { updates.push('bezirk_code = ?'); params.push(bezirk_code); }  // <-- LINE 298
  updates.push("updated_at = datetime('now')");
  params.push(req.params.rid);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE signal_reports SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
  // ... returns updated report
});
```

The endpoint accepts `bezirk_code` in the request body and updates it in the database (line 298). However, the frontend does NOT currently send this field.

**Important Discovery:** 
- LandMode.tsx line 176-178: The `handleUpdate()` PATCH call does NOT include bezirk_code:
  ```typescript
  body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null })
  ```
- BundMode.tsx line 190-192: Same issue - bezirk_code is missing from the PATCH:
  ```typescript
  body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null })
  ```

### 4. HOW REPORTS ARE FILTERED/GROUPED BY BEZIRK

**LandMode.tsx:**
- Lines 196-298: Reports are grouped by repeater, then sub-grouped by bezirk
- Line 200: `const repBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === rep.bundesland_code);`
- Gets all bezirke for the repeater's Bundesland
- Line 240: `const bzReports = repReports.filter(r => r.bezirk_code === bz.code);`
- Filters reports matching each bezirk code
- Lines 258-277: "Sonstige" section groups reports without matching bezirk_code
- Line 264: `bezirk={{ code: '??', name: 'Sonstige', is_capital: false }}`

**BundMode.tsx:**
- Lines 212-348: Reports are grouped by Bundesland first, then by bezirk
- Lines 214-228: Complex filtering logic for linked repeaters:
  ```typescript
  const blReports = reports.filter(r => {
    if (!r.repeater_is_linked) return false;  // Only linked repeaters
    if (r.bezirk_code && blBezirkCodes.has(r.bezirk_code)) return true;  // Primary: match by bezirk
    if (!r.bezirk_code) {
      const effectiveBl = domesticBlCodes.has(r.bundesland_code) ? r.bundesland_code : r.repeater_bundesland_code;
      return effectiveBl === bl.code;  // Fallback: use operator or repeater BL
    }
    return false;
  });
  ```
- Line 304: `const bzReports = blReports.filter(r => r.bezirk_code === bz.code);`
- Similar "Sonstige" handling at lines 323-343

### 5. BEZIRK DATA AVAILABLE IN EACH COMPONENT

**LandMode.tsx:**
- Line 39: `const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);`
- Lines 45-49: Loads bezirke from `/api/v1/reference/bezirke`
- Line 200: `const repBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === rep.bundesland_code);`
- Has full bezirk list filtered by Bundesland for each repeater
- Each BezirkRow receives a bezirk object with: `{ code, name, is_capital }`

**BundMode.tsx:**
- Line 24: `const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);`
- Lines 37-44: Loads bezirke from `/api/v1/reference/bezirke` alongside bundeslaender
- Line 214: `const blBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === bl.code);`
- For each Bundesland, filters to get relevant bezirke
- Each BezirkRow receives a bezirk object with: `{ code, name, is_capital }`

---

## Summary of Current State

The system has a **complete backend implementation** for bezirk_code updates, but the **frontend UI is missing the bezirk edit field**. Currently:

- Reports ARE assigned bezirk_code at creation time based on which BezirkRow section they're submitted under
- Reports are displayed grouped by bezirk in both modes
- The PATCH endpoint fully supports changing bezirk_code
- **But there is NO UI to edit the bezirk_code after report creation** - the inline edit form only allows editing rapport, notes, operator name/QTH

This is a complete disconnect between backend capability and frontend UI implementation.

   369→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   370→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   371→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);

   379→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   380→    e.preventDefault();
   381→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   382→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   383→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   384→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   385→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   386→  };
   387→
   388→  const saveOperatorField = (field: 'name' | 'qth', value: string) => {
   389→    if (!form.operator?.id) return;
   390→    const original = field === 'name' ? (form.operator.name || '') : (form.operator.qth || '');
   391→    if (value === original) return;
   392→    apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${form.operator.id}`, {
   393→      method: 'PATCH',
   394→      body: JSON.stringify({ [field]: value || null }),
   395→    }).then(() => {
   396→      setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: { ...f.operator, [field]: value || null } }));
   397→    }).catch(() => {});
   398→  };
   399→
   400→  return (
   401→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   402→      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   403→        <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.code === '??' ? 'bg-[#ffc107] text-gray-800' : bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   404→          {bezirk.code === '??' ? '??' : bezirk.code}
   405→        </span>
   406→        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   407→        {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   408→      </div>

   410→      {reports.length > 0 && (

   418→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   419→                      <input value={editForm.opName} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opName: e.target.value })} placeholder="Name" className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 hidden sm:block" />
   420→                      <input value={editForm.opQth} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opQth: e.target.value })} placeholder="QTH" className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-14 sm:w-16 hidden sm:block" />
   421→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" autoFocus />
   422→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   423→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>

   452→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (

   456→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs max-w-[80px] sm:max-w-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"

   483→        />
   484→        <input

   486→          value={form.opQth}

   488→          onBlur={e => saveOperatorField('qth', e.target.value)}
   489→          placeholder="QTH"
   490→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 hidden sm:block"
   491→        />
   492→        <input

   497→          placeholder="5/9"
   498→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   499→          onKeyDown={e => {
   500→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {

   506→        <input

   510→          placeholder="Sonst."
   511→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   512→        />
   513→        <button type="submit" title="Rapport speichern (Enter)" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs flex-shrink-0">
   514→          + ↵
   515→        </button>
   516→      </form>
   517→    </div>
   518→  );

(\n                  <td colSpan={6} className=\"py-0.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap\" onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); onEditSave(); } }}>\n                      <span className=\"font-mono font-medium\">{r.callsign}</span>\n                      <input value={editForm.opName} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opName: e.target.value })} placeholder=\"Name\" className=\"border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 hidden sm:block\" />\n                      <input value={editForm.opQth} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opQth: e.target.value })} placeholder=\"QTH\" className=\"border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-14 sm:w-16 hidden sm:block\" />\n                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className=\"border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20\" autoFocus />\n                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder=\"Sonst.\" className=\"border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20\" />\n                      <select\n                        value={editForm.bezirkCode}\n                        onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, bezirkCode: e.target.value })}\n                        className=\"border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-14 sm:w-16\"\n                        title=\"Bezirk\"\n                      >\n                        <option value=\"\">??</option>\n                        {availableBezirke.map(bz => <option key={bz.code} value={bz.code}>{bz.code}</option>)}\n                      </select>\n                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className=\"text-green-600 text-xs font-bold\">OK</button>\n                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs\">X</button>\n                    </div>\n                  </td>\n                ) : (\n                  <>\n                    <td className=\"py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4 cursor-grab\">{idx + 1}</td>\n                    <td className=\"py-0.5 cursor-pointer\" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>\n                      <span className=\"font-mono font-medium\">{r.callsign}</span>\n                      {r.operator_name && <span                   </td>\n                    <td className=\"py-0.5 text-blue-600 text-xs cursor-pointer hidden sm:table-cell\" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.repeater_name || ''}</td>\n onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>\n                    <td className=\"py-0.5 w-4\">\n                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className=\"text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0  <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (\n          <select\n            value={repeaterId || ''}\n            onChange={e => > AGENT

Build succeeds. Here's what was implemented:

**Both LandMode (Frequenzen) and BundMode (OE-Link):**

1. **Bezirk dropdown in edit mode** — when you click a report to edit it, a Bezirk `<select>` dropdown now appears alongside Rapport, Notes, etc. Change the bezirk code and click OK to move the report.

2. **Drag & drop** — report rows are `draggable`. Drag a report row and drop it on any Bezirk section within the same repeater/Bundesland. The drop target highlights blue (`ring-2 ring-blue-400`) on hover. The dragged row fades (`opacity-40`) while dragging. On drop, the `bezirk_code` is updated via PATCH.

3. **No backend changes needed** — the PATCH endpoint already supported `bezirk_code` updates.

Both methods work:
- **Dropdown**: works on all devices including mobile/touch
- **Drag & drop**: works on desktop, provides quick visual reordering

Excellent. I have all four key files. Let me now look more closely at how simplex repeaters flow through the rendering logic, particularly around the `repBezirke` logic.

Looking at **LandMode.tsx** (lines 62-74):

```typescript

const simplexRepeaters: any[] = [];
for (const r of repeaters) {
  if (r.is_linked) continue;
  if (r.type === 'simplex') {
    simplexRepeaters.push(r);
  } else {
    const blCode = r.bundesland_code || '_other';
    if (!repeatersByBl[blCode]) repeatersByBl[blCode] = [];
    repeatersByBl[blCode].push(r);
  }
}
```

Then in `renderRepeaterCard` (line 209-321), the critical logic is at **line 213**:

```typescript

```

This is the issue! For simplex repeaters, `rep.bundesland_code` is likely `null` or `undefined` (since they're not tied to a Bundesland). This means `repBezirke` will be empty, and the code will take the **FlatReportRow** path (line 304) instead of **BezirkRow** path.

  const db = getDb();
  const { notes, name, oe_link_enabled, organisator, exercise_type } = req.body;
  const updates: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];
  if (notes !== undefined) { updates.push('notes = ?'); params.push(notes); }
  if (name !== undefined) { updates.push('name = ?'); params.push(name); }

  if (organisator !== undefined) { updates.push('organisator = ?'); params.push(organisator); }

This shows the pattern clearly: boolean flags are converted `? 1 : 0` when saving.

Now let me create a comprehensive report of my findings.

## Summary of Findings

### 1. **Simplex Rendering in LandMode.tsx (lines 62-74, 209-321)**

**How simplex repeaters are currently rendered:**

- Simplex repeaters are filtered into a separate `simplexRepeaters` array (line 64-68) because they have `r.type === 'simplex'`
- They skip `renderRepeaterCard` grouping by Bundesland since there's a separate "Simplex" section (lines 340-349)
- Each simplex repeater goes through the same `renderRepeaterCard` function as regular repeaters
- **Critical logic at line 213**: `const repBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === rep.bundesland_code);`

**The problem:** For simplex repeaters, `bundesland_code` is `null` (they're not tied to a state), so `repBezirke` will be empty. This causes the code to render using **FlatReportRow** (line 304) instead of **BezirkRow** (lines 250-301).

**Flow:**
- Simplex repeaters appear under a "Simplex" heading (line 343)
- Each goes through `renderRepeaterCard`
- Since `repBezirke.length === 0`, it skips the BezirkRow rendering (lines 250-301)
- Falls through to FlatReportRow (lines 302-316) — a flat list without bezirk organization

---

### 2. **Simplex Configuration in ExerciseSetupPage.tsx (lines 441-487)**

**How simplex frequencies are currently configured:**

- All repeaters are fetched from the API (line 62)
- Simplex repeaters are filtered separately: `const simplexRepeaters = allRepeaters.filter(r => r.type === 'simplex');` (line 82)
- They have their own dedicated section "Simplex-Frequenzen" (line 444)
- Simple checkbox toggle to activate/deactivate (lines 451-456)
- Custom simplex repeater creation form (lines 470-485)
  - When adding custom simplex: `type = 'simplex'` and `bundesland_code = null` (line 136)
  - Only requires Name and Frequency (no Offset/CTCSS/Callsign)

**Per-exercise settings:**
- The page already demonstrates the pattern for exercise-level toggles with the **OE-Link checkbox** (lines 292-330)
- This toggle sets/unsets `oe_link_enabled` on the exercise
- When enabled, it auto-adds all linked repeaters to the exercise

---

### 3. **Exercises Table Schema (schema.ts, lines 70-211)**

**Current exercise columns:**
- `id` (TEXT PRIMARY KEY) — UUID
- `name` (TEXT) — optional
- `date` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `notes` (TEXT)
- `oe_link_enabled` (INTEGER DEFAULT 1) — added via migration (line 202-203)
- `organisator` (TEXT) — added via migration (line 205-206)
- `exercise_type` (TEXT DEFAULT 'Krisenkommunikationsübung') — added via migration (line 208-210)
- `created_at` (TEXT DEFAULT datetime('now'))

**Pattern for adding exercise-level settings:**
- Each setting is a simple column (boolean stored as 0/1, or text)
- Migrations use `PRAGMA table_info` to detect missing columns, then `ALTER TABLE`
- New boolean toggles would follow the same pattern: add column in migration, then handle in PATCH endpoint

---

### 4. **Exercise PATCH Endpoint (exercises.ts, lines 78-96)**

**How boolean flags are handled:**

The PATCH endpoint accepts arbitrary fields and builds dynamic SQL:

```typescript
if (oe_link_enabled !== undefined) { 
  updates.push('oe_link_enabled = ?'); 
  params.push(oe_link_enabled ? 1 : 0);  // <-- converts JS boolean to SQLite 0/1
}
```

**Pattern established:**
- JavaScript sends `{ oe_link_enabled: true/false }`
- Endpoint converts with ternary: `oe_link_enabled ? 1 : 0`
- SQLite stores as INTEGER (0 or 1)
- When reading back, JavaScript treats 0/1 as falsy/truthy

This exact pattern could be reused for any new boolean exercise setting (e.g., `simplex_enabled`, `hide_bezirke`, etc.).

---

### Key Observations for a Proposed Feature

If you want to add an exercise-level toggle to hide/show simplex frequencies or change their rendering:

1. **Add schema column** (in schema.ts migration):
   ```sql
   ALTER TABLE exercises ADD COLUMN simplex_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1
   ```

2. **Add to PATCH handler** (in exercises.ts):
   ```typescript
   if (simplex_enabled !== undefined) { 
     updates.push('simplex_enabled = ?'); 
     params.push(simplex_enabled ? 1 : 0); 
   }
   ```

3. **Read in UI** (ExerciseSetupPage.tsx):
   - Add checkbox next to OE-Link toggle (same pattern, lines 292-330)
   - On change, PATCH the exercise with the new flag

4. **Conditionally render in LandMode.tsx**:
   - Check `exercise.simplex_enabled` before rendering the simplex section (line 340)
   - Or conditionally use different rendering logic based on this flag

The architecture is already set up to support this—it's just a matter of adding the column, endpoint logic, and UI integration.

    35→

    58→    });
    59→    socket.on('report_updated', (data: any) => {

   120→        </h1>
   121→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
   122→          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

   124→            <input

   157→          >

    83→

    85→    await withSave(async () => {
    86→      const isActive = activeBundeslaender.has(blCode);
    87→      const newSet = new Set(activeBundeslaender);
    88→      const newExpanded = new Set(expandedBl);
    89→
    90→      if (isActive) {
    91→        const blReps = repeatersForBl(blCode);
    92→        for (const rep of blReps) {
    93→          if (activeRepeaters.some(r => r.repeater_id === rep.id)) {
    94→            await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters/${rep.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    95→          }
    96→        }
    97→        newSet.delete(blCode);
    98→        newExpanded.delete(blCode);
    99→        setActiveRepeaters(prev => prev.filter(r => {
   100→          const rep = allRepeaters.find(ar => ar.id === r.repeater_id);
   101→          return rep?.bundesland_code !== blCode;
   102→        }));
   103→      } else {
   104→        newSet.add(blCode);
   105→        newExpanded.add(blCode);
   106→      }
   107→
   108→      setActiveBundeslaender(newSet);
   109→      setExpandedBl(newExpanded);
   110→    });
   111→  };
   112→
   113→  const toggleRepeater = async (repeaterId: number) => {
   114→    const isActive = activeRepeaters.some(r => r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
   115→    if (isActive) {
   116→      if (!isAdmin) return;
   117→      await withSave(async () => {
   118→        await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters/${repeaterId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   119→        setActiveRepeaters(prev => prev.filter(r => r.repeater_id !== repeaterId));
   120→      });
   121→    } else {
   122→      await withSave(async () => {
   123→        await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`, {
   124→          method: 'POST',
   125→          body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repeaterId }),
   126→        });
   127→        const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`);
   128→        setActiveRepeaters(updated);
   129→      });
   130→    }
   131→  };
   132→
   133→  const addCustomRepeater = async (bundeslandCode: string | null) => {
   134→    if (!newRepName && !newRepFreq) return;
   135→    await withSave(async () => {
   136→      const type = bundeslandCode === null ? 'simplex' : 'repeater';
   137→      const name = newRepName || `Direkte ${newRepFreq}`;
   138→      const rep = await apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters', {
   139→        method: 'POST',
   140→        body: JSON.stringify({
   141→          short_name: name,
   142→          frequency_mhz: newRepFreq ? parseFloat(newRepFreq) : null,
   143→          offset_mhz: newRepOffset ? parseFloat(newRepOffset) : null,
   144→          ctcss_hz: newRepCtcss ? parseFloat(newRepCtcss) : null,
   145→          callsign: newRepCallsign || null,
   146→          band: newRepFreq ? (parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 400 ? '70cm' : parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 200 ? '23cm' : '2m') : null,
   147→          type,
   148→          bundesland_code: bundeslandCode,
   149→        }),
   150→      });
   151→      setAllRepeaters(prev => [...prev, rep]);
   152→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`, {
   153→        method: 'POST',
   154→        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: rep.id }),
   155→      });
   156→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`);
   157→      setActiveRepeaters(updated);
   158→      setNewRepName('');
   159→      setNewRepFreq('');
   160→      setNewRepOffset('');
   161→      setNewRepCtcss('');
   162→      setNewRepCallsign('');
   163→      setShowAddForm(null);
   164→    });
   165→  };
   166→
   167→  const toggleExpanded = (blCode: string) => {
   168→    setExpandedBl(prev => {
   169→      const next = new Set(prev);
   170→      if (next.has(blCode)) next.delete(blCode);
   171→      else next.add(blCode);
   172→      return next;
   173→    });
   174→  };
   175→
   176→  if (loading) return <p className="text-gray-500">Laden...</p>;
   177→  if (!exercise) return <p className="text-red-500">Übung nicht gefunden</p>;
   178→
   179→  return (
   180→    <div className="space-y-6">
   181→      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
   182→        <h1 className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold text-[#1e3a5f] min-w-0">
   183→          <span className="block sm:inline">Übung einrichten</span>
   184→          <span className="hidden sm:inline"> — </span>
   185→          <span className="block sm:inline text-sm sm:text-xl">{new Date(exercise.date + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('de-AT')}</span>
   186→        </h1>
   187→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 flex-shrink-0">
   188→          {saveStatus === 'saving' && (
   189→            <span className="text-xs text-amber-600 animate-pulse">Speichern...</span>
   190→          )}
   191→          {saveStatus === 'saved' && (
   192→            <span className="text-xs text-green-600">Gespeichert</span>
   193→          )}
   194→          {saveStatus === 'error' && (
   195→            <span className="text-xs text-red-600">Fehler!</span>
   196→          )}
   197→          {isAdmin && (
   198→            <button
   199→              onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(true)}
   200→              className="bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-700 px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs sm:text-sm"
   201→            >
   202→              Löschen
   203→            </button>
   204→          )}
   205→          <Link to={`/exercises/${id}`} className="bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-700 px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs sm:text-sm">
   206→            Zurück
   207→          </Link>
   208→        </div>
   209→      </div>
   210→
   211→      {/* Exercise type + name (admin only) */}
   212→      {isAdmin && (
   213→        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-3 sm:p-4">
   214→          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-[#1e3a5f] mb-2 sm:mb-3">Typ & Name der Übung</h2>
   215→          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
   216→            <div>
   217→              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Übungstyp</label>
   218→              <div className="flex gap-2">
   219→                <select
   220→                  value={EXERCISE_TYPES.some(t => t.value === (exercise.exercise_type || '')) ? exercise.exercise_type : '__custom__'}
   221→                  onChange={async (e) => {
   222→                    if (e.target.value === '__custom__') {
   223→                      setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, exercise_type: '' } : null);
   224→                    } else {
   225→                      const val = e.target.value;
   226→                      await withSave(() => apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
   227→                        method: 'PATCH',
   228→                        body: JSON.stringify({ exercise_type: val }),
   229→                      }));
   230→                      setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, exercise_type: val } : null);
   231→                    }
   232→                  }}
   233→                  className="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
   234→                >
   235→                  {EXERCISE_TYPES.map(t => (
   236→                    <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</option>
   237→                  ))}
   238→                  <option value="__custom__">Eigener Typ...</option>
   239→                </select>
   240→                {!EXERCISE_TYPES.some(t => t.value === (exercise.exercise_type || '')) && (
   241→                  <input
   242→                    type="text"
   243→                    value={exercise.exercise_type || ''}
   244→                    onChange={e => setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, exercise_type: e.target.value } : null)}
   245→                    onBlur={async (e) => {
   246→                      if (e.target.value) {
   247→                        await withSave(() => apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
   248→                          method: 'PATCH',
   249→                          body: JSON.stringify({ exercise_type: e.target.value }),
   250→                        }));
   251→                      }
   252→                    }}
   253→                    placeholder="Typ eingeben"
   254→                    className="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm flex-1 min-w-[140px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
   255→                    autoFocus
   256→                  />
   257→                )}
   258→              </div>
   259→            </div>
   260→            <div className="flex-1">
   261→              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Name (optional)</label>
   262→              <input
   263→                type="text"
   264→                value={exerciseName}
   265→                placeholder="z.B. Sonntagsrunde KW 07"
   266→                onChange={(e) => {
   267→                  const val = e.target.value;
   268→                  setExerciseName(val);
   269→                  if (nameSaveTimer) clearTimeout(nameSaveTimer);
   270→                  setNameSaveTimer(setTimeout(async () => {
   271→                    await withSave(() => apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
   272→                      method: 'PATCH',
   273→                      body: JSON.stringify({ name: val || null }),
   274→                    }));
   275→                  }, 800));
   276→                }}
   277→                onBlur={async () => {
   278→                  if (nameSaveTimer) clearTimeout(nameSaveTimer);
   279→                  setNameSaveTimer(null);
   280→                  await withSave(() => apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
   281→                    method: 'PATCH',
   282→                    body: JSON.stringify({ name: exerciseName || null }),
   283→                  }));
   284→                }}
   285→                className="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm w-full max-w-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
   286→              />
   287→            </div>
   288→          </div>
   289→        </div>
   290→      )}
   291→
   292→      {/* OE-Link toggle (admin only) */}
   293→      {isAdmin && (
   294→        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-3 sm:p-4">
   295→          <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer">
   296→            <input
   297→              type="checkbox"
   298→              checked={exercise.oe_link_enabled !== 0}
   299→              onChange={async (e) => {
   300→                const val = e.target.checked;
   301→                await withSave(async () => {
   302→                  await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
   303→                    method: 'PATCH',
   304→                    body: JSON.stringify({ oe_link_enabled: val }),
   305→                  });
   306→                  setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, oe_link_enabled: val ? 1 : 0 } : null);
   307→                  if (val) {
   308→                    const linkedReps = allRepeaters.filter(r => r.is_linked);
   309→                    for (const rep of linkedReps) {
   310→                      if (!activeRepeaters.some(r => r.repeater_id === rep.id)) {
   311→                        await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`, {
   312→                          method: 'POST',
   313→                          body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: rep.id }),
   314→                        });
   315→                      }
   316→                    }
   317→                    const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`);
   318→                    setActiveRepeaters(updated);
   319→                  }
   320→                });
   321→              }}
   322→              className="w-5 h-5 accent-red-600"
   323→            />
   324→            <div>
   325→              <span className="font-semibold text-[#1e3a5f] text-sm sm:text-base">OE-Link aktivieren</span>
   326→              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">OE-Link-Tab und Auswertung anzeigen (deaktivieren für Übungen ohne OE-Link, z.B. 80m Notfunk Runde)</p>
   327→            </div>
   328→          </label>
   329→        </div>
   330→      )}
   331→
   332→      {/* Bundesländer selection */}
   333→      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-3 sm:p-4">
   334→        <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-[#1e3a5f] mb-2 sm:mb-3">Bundesländer auswählen</h2>
   335→        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-9 gap-2">
   336→          {BUNDESLAENDER.map(bl => {
   337→            const isActive = activeBundeslaender.has(bl.code);
   338→            const repCount = repeatersForBl(bl.code).length;
   339→            const activeCount = activeRepeaters.filter(ar => {
   340→              const rep = allRepeaters.find(r => r.id === ar.repeater_id);
   341→              return rep?.bundesland_code === bl.code && !rep?.is_linked;
   342→            }).length;
   343→            return (
   344→              <button
   345→                key={bl.code}
   346→                onClick={() => isAdmin && toggleBundesland(bl.code)}
   347→                disabled={!isAdmin}
   348→                className={`flex flex-col items-center py-2 px-1 rounded-lg border-2 transition-colors text-sm ${
   349→                  isActive
   350→                    ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50 text-[#1e3a5f]'
   351→                    : 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 hover:border-gray-300'
   352→                } ${!isAdmin ? 'cursor-default' : ''}`}
   353→              >
   354→                <span className="font-bold">{bl.label}</span>
   355→                <span className="text-xs truncate w-full text-center">{bl.name}</span>
   356→                {isActive && <span className="text-xs mt-0.5">{activeCount}/{repCount}</span>}
   357→              </button>
   358→            );
   359→          })}
   360→        </div>
   361→      </div>
   362→
   363→      {/* Per-Bundesland repeater sections */}
   364→      {BUNDESLAENDER.filter(bl => activeBundeslaender.has(bl.code)).map(bl => {
   365→        const blRepeaters = repeatersForBl(bl.code);
   366→        const isExpanded = expandedBl.has(bl.code);
   367→
   368→        return (
   369→          <div key={bl.code} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-hidden">
   370→            <button
   371→              onClick={() => toggleExpanded(bl.code)}
   372→              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
   373→            >
   374→              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   375→                <span className="font-bold text-[#1e3a5f]">{bl.label}</span>
   376→                <span className="font-semibold text-[#1e3a5f]">{bl.name}</span>
   377→                <span className="text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
   378→                  {activeRepeaters.filter(ar => {
   379→                    const rep = allRepeaters.find(r => r.id === ar.repeater_id);
   380→                    return rep?.bundesland_code === bl.code;
   381→                  }).length} / {blRepeaters.length}
   382→                </span>
   383→              </div>
   384→              <span className="text-gray-400">{isExpanded ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
   385→            </button>
   386→
   387→            {isExpanded && (
   388→              <div className="border-t px-4 pb-4">
   389→                <div className="space-y-1 mt-2">
   390→                  {blRepeaters.map(rep => {
   391→                    const active = activeRepeaters.find(r => r.repeater_id === rep.id);
   392→                    return (
   393→                      <div key={rep.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-100">
   394→                        <label className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 flex-1 flex-wrap ${!active || isAdmin ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}`}>
   395→                          <input
   396→                            type="checkbox"
   397→                            checked={!!active}
   398→                            disabled={!!active && !isAdmin}
   399→                            onChange={() => toggleRepeater(rep.id)}
   400→                            className="w-4 h-4 accent-red-600 flex-shrink-0"
   401→                          />
   402→                          <span className="font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm">{rep.short_name}{rep.callsign ? ` (${rep.callsign})` : ''}</span>
   403→                          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 hidden sm:inline">
   404→                            {rep.frequency_mhz && `${rep.frequency_mhz} MHz`}
   405→                          </span>
   406→                          {rep.ctcss_hz && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden md:inline">CTCSS {rep.ctcss_hz}</span>}
   407→                          {rep.is_linked ? <span className="text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">oelink</span> : null}
   408→                          {rep.is_custom ? <span className="text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">custom</span> : null}
   409→                        </label>
   410→                      </div>
   411→                    );
   412→                  })}
   413→                </div>
   414→
   415→                {/* Add custom repeater button */}
   416→                {showAddForm === bl.code ? (
   417→                  <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg space-y-2">
   418→                    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

   420→                      <input type="text" placeholder="Frequenz MHz" value={newRepFreq} onChange={e => setNewRepFreq(e.target.value)} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm w-28" />
   421→                      <input type="text" placeholder="Offset MHz" value={newRepOffset} onChange={e => setNewRepOffset(e.target.value)} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm w-24" />
   422→                      <input type="text" placeholder="CTCSS Hz" value={newRepCtcss} onChange={e => setNewRepCtcss(e.target.value)} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm w-24" />
   423→                      <input type="text" placeholder="Rufzeichen" value={newRepCallsign} onChange={e => setNewRepCallsign(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-mono uppercase w-24" />
   424→                    </div>
   425→                    <div className="flex gap-2">
   426→                      <button onClick={() => addCustomRepeater(bl.code)} className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded text-sm">Hinzufügen</button>
   427→                      <button onClick={() => setShowAddForm(null)} className="text-gray-500 text-sm hover:text-gray-700">Abbrechen</button>
   428→                    </div>
   429→                  </div>
   430→                ) : (
   431→                  <button onClick={() => setShowAddForm(bl.code)} className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700 hover:text-red-900 font-medium">
   432→                    + Umsetzer hinzufügen
   433→                  </button>
   434→                )}
   435→              </div>
   436→            )}
   437→          </div>
   438→        );
   439→      })}
   440→
   441→      {/* Simplex frequencies */}
   442→      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-hidden">
   443→        <div className="p-4">
   444→          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#1e3a5f] mb-3">Simplex-Frequenzen</h2>
   445→          <div className="space-y-1">
   446→            {simplexRepeaters.map(rep => {
   447→              const active = activeRepeaters.find(r => r.repeater_id === rep.id);
   448→              return (
   449→                <div key={rep.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-100">
   450→                  <label className={`flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 ${!active || isAdmin ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}`}>
   451→                    <input
   452→                      type="checkbox"
   453→                      checked={!!active}
   454→                      disabled={!!active && !isAdmin}
   455→                      onChange={() => toggleRepeater(rep.id)}
   456→                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-red-600"
   457→                    />
   458→                    <span className="font-medium text-sm">{rep.short_name}</span>
   459→                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
   460→                      {rep.frequency_mhz && `${rep.frequency_mhz} MHz`}
   461→                    </span>
   462→                    {rep.is_custom ? <span className="text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">custom</span> : null}
   463→                  </label>
   464→                </div>
   465→              );
   466→            })}
   467→          </div>
   468→
   469→          {/* Add custom simplex */}
   470→          {showAddForm === 'simplex' ? (
   471→            <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg space-y-2">
   472→              <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
   473→                <input type="text" placeholder="Name (optional)" value={newRepName} onChange={e => setNewRepName(e.target.value)} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm flex-1 min-w-[120px]" />
   474→                <input type="text" placeholder="Frequenz MHz" value={newRepFreq} onChange={e => setNewRepFreq(e.target.value)} className="border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm w-28" />
   475→              </div>
   476→              <div className="flex gap-2">
   477→                <button onClick={() => addCustomRepeater(null)} className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded text-sm">Hinzufügen</button>
   478→                <button onClick={() => setShowAddForm(null)} className="text-gray-500 text-sm hover:text-gray-700">Abbrechen</button>
   479→              </div>
   480→            </div>
   481→          ) : (
   482→            <button onClick={() => setShowAddForm('simplex')} className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700 hover:text-red-900 font-medium">
   483→              + Simplex-Frequenz hinzufügen
   484→            </button>
   485→          )}
   486→        </div>
   487→      </div>
   488→
   489→      {/* Delete confirmation modal */}
   490→      {showDeleteConfirm && (
   491→        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
   492→          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl max-w-md w-full p-6">
   493→            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-red-700 mb-2">Übung löschen?</h3>
   494→            <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-1">
   495→              <span className="font-semibold">{exercise.name || 'Übung'}</span> vom {new Date(exercise.date + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('de-AT')}
   496→            </p>
   497→            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">
   498→              Alle Rapporte, Teilnehmer und Umsetzer-Zuordnungen werden unwiderruflich gelöscht.
   499→            </p>
   500→            <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
   501→              <p className="text-xs text-red-800 font-medium">Diese Aktion kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden!</p>
   502→            </div>
   503→            <div className="flex gap-3 justify-end">
   504→              <button
   505→                onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}
   506→                disabled={deleting}
   507→                className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-lg"
   508→              >
   509→                Abbrechen
   510→              </button>
   511→              <button
   512→                onClick={async () => {
   513→                  setDeleting(true);
   514→                  try {
   515→                    await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   516→                    navigate('/');
   517→                  } catch {} finally {
   518→                    setDeleting(false);
   519→                  }
